mapper.insert: INSERT INTO issue_report (title, issue_type, status, reporter_id, reporter_name, reservoir_name, lat, lng, description, photos, assigned_to, assigned_name, patrol_task_id, admin_remark) VALUES (#{title}, #{issueType}, #{status}, #{reporterId}, #{reporterName}, #{reservoirName}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{description}, #{photos}, #{assignedTo}, #{assignedName}, #{patrolTaskId}, #{adminRemark})
mapper.update: UPDATE issue_report SET title = #{title}, issue_type = #{issueType}, status = #{status}, reservoir_name = #{reservoirName}, lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}, description = #{description}, photos = #{photos}, assigned_to = #{assignedTo}, assigned_name = #{assignedName}, patrol_task_id = #{patrolTaskId}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issue_report WHERE status = #{status}
